entries.name: WATCHSEARCH_IMPORT_DIR
entries.description: Folder where WhatsApp chat exports from the store's dealer groups are saved, one .txt file per group, named after the group. Never inside a git repo.
howToGet: Create a folder outside any git repo.

In WhatsApp, open each dealer group, choose Export chat > Without media, and save the .txt file into the folder named after the group, such as Rolex Dealers HK.txt. On iPhone the export is a zip holding _chat.txt: unzip it and rename the file.
Export again whenever you want fresh offers; a newer export of the same group replaces the old file, and offers already read are recognized.

entries.name: WATCHSEARCH_DEALER_KEY
entries.description: The instance's own key for turning dealer names and numbers into dealer references (HMAC-SHA256), so offers from the same dealer line up without the name or number being kept. Changing it gives every dealer a new reference, so it is never rotated.
howToGet: Generated automatically by npm run secrets:setup. Keep a copy in the password manager: losing it means earlier offers no longer line up with new ones by dealer.

entries.name: WATCHSEARCH_DATE_ORDER
entries.description: How the phone that exports the chats writes dates: auto, dmy (22/10/2026) or mdy (10/22/2026). Auto works it out from each file.
howToGet: Leave as auto. Set dmy or mdy only when a sync says a file's dates could be read either way, which happens when every message in it is from the first 12 days of a month.

entries.name: WATCHSEARCH_UTC_OFFSET
entries.description: The exporting phone's offset from UTC, such as +08:00 or -05:00. Exports carry the phone's local times.
howToGet: Use the time zone of the phone that exports the chats. Leave it empty for UTC.

entries.name: WATCHSEARCH_CURRENCY
entries.description: The currency the store's groups mean when a dealer writes a bare price such as 14.5k. Without it, those prices are left out and only prices with a currency are kept.
howToGet: Set it when most of the store's groups trade in one currency, using its three-letter code (USD, EUR, HKD).
